title: PRISM Studio proposed domain contracts 2.0.0
description: Original implementation handoff. Local shape validation only; domain invariants, authority, reference integrity, integer decoding and filesystem checks remain authoritative-core responsibilities. This file is not a production implementation.

Id.description: Opaque identity generated by the core or official client ID allocator and admitted by the core. Never interpret as a path, existing ownership or authority.

SafeRelativePath.description: Shape only. Core must additionally normalize, confine and resolve symlinks at access time.

Money.description: Exact minor-unit amount. Runtime validates currency/exponent pair and requires integer-decoded values; JSON Schema integer semantics alone do not reject an integral decimal spelling such as1.0.

ArtifactVersion.description: Immutable complete version only. Blob location is derived from digest; staging/availability is separate. Filesystem integrity and references need semantic validation.

DomainEvent.description: Immutable fact pointing to the exact canonical typed entity snapshot in the local blob store. Publishing requires the snapshot and state to be durable; no external effect on replay. Null project is legal only in the local profile/host configuration realm.

RunView.description: Bounded presentation projection, never authorization. Allowed actions equal enabled action states for this principal/scope; the core rechecks every mutation.

ThemeTarget.description: Opaque registered target, bound to current principal/project/host capability. Never a caller-controlled filesystem path.

CreateRunInput.description: Absent settings resolve from project/personal/capability policy. Supplied settings request a complete explicit invocation override, subject to actual authority; persisted origins and capability claims are derived by the core.

InitializeProjectInput.description: Core resolves the source/state roots from an existing scoped host/workspace grant; an arbitrary client path does not create permission. Creates initial defaults snapshot, Project and private WorkspaceBinding.

BatchReviewInput.description: Create a new batch or explicitly revise membership under expected BatchReview.revision. Item IDs persist across membership revisions; the core verifies request versions/artifacts/fingerprints.

PrepareProviderInput.description: Core derives attempt number, resolved model, request fingerprint and billing currency from the task plus verified adapter capabilities. No external execution or spend occurs.

HeartbeatInput.description: The core sets heartbeat/expiry from its clock and configured bounded lease policy. Progress is reported only when the adapter can measure it.
